name: PpTextUnitEffect
description: Constants that specify how text-unit effects are animated, passed to and returned by the TextUnitEffect property of the AnimationSettings object.

constants.name: ppAnimateUnitMixed
constants.description: Text-unit effects are animated in a mixed manner.

constants.name: ppAnimateByParagraph
constants.description: Text-unit effects are animated by paragraph.

constants.name: ppAnimateByWord
constants.description: Text-unit effects are animated by word.

constants.name: ppAnimateByCharacter
constants.description: Text-unit effects are animated by character.
